Bryan Cranston Mourns Death of "Breaking Bad" Son RJ Mitte

Actor Bryan Cranston is mourning the death of RJ Mitte, who played his on-screen son in the television series "Breaking Bad." The cause of death has been confirmed, though details were not specified in the coverage. Cranston has led tributes to Mitte.
